none: PAS CAM-585F22: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine II as Caesar
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine II as Caesar. Mint is uncertain, ADc.330-340, (Reece perid 17). Reverse reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers and one standard. Obverse shows laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]S IVN NOB C. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is very fine. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 0.55g,…
